dense_gpu_replay_policy.artifact_policy: Reuse saved ranking only when top-100 candidate IDs match; generated-view per-document cosine score drift must be within tolerance, and single-view cached order must remain score-sorted within tolerance. Evaluation consumes the saved ranking.

ablation.notes: A3/A4 use equal-weight two-channel RRF at k=60. FUSION_BAD means A5 failed to beat the best of A1-A4; it does not mean only that CRB lost to an external GAR baseline. All ablations are DEV-only diagnostics.

stop_rule: No TEST unless the predeclared DEV gate is positive; a negative result ends this R2MED CRB sprint after the predefined ablation.

diagnostic_reanalysis.scope: Reclassified saved DEV ablation summaries only; no rankings, generation, qrels, or TEST inputs were read.
